title: Episode assembly and domain projections

files.change: Group reviewed claims by stable product/phase, preserving chronological and causal distinctions.
Single owner for projecting claims into existing product/price/regulatory/leadership tables.
Read reviewed claims; preserve version/region/billing/tax/promotional semantics.
Explicit action/period dates, stable claim links and intentional review-state mapping.
Central eligibility compatibility bridge; keep date_conflicts holds.

steps: Build a deterministic episode skeleton first; attach situation/actions/results/gaps with claim IDs.
Use inclusive date intervals for uncertain facts, not false ordering. Don't assume every domain track applies.
Prices across time require comparable units/terms; no undocumented inflation or currency conversion.
Replace per-feature duplicate writing paths with shared projection function, not an all-at-once refactor.
tests: Apple incorporation cannot become product-validation chapter.
One source with multiple topics populates tracks without duplicate events.
Projection replay idempotent; price conflicts coexist at claim layer; old Company360 remains readable.
completion_evidence: legacy-vs-new projection comparison with documented differences
